name: Remind Once
description: Set a one-off job: at a local date-time, AnythingLLM's agent gets the prompt, with no chat history and only the tools given, and its reply arrives as a notification; the job is deleted once it has run. For a plain reminder, a prompt such as "Remind the user to stretch." and no tools. Call without apply first, show the user the preview (prompt, tools, time), and call again with apply: true only once they agree.
author: anything

name.description: A short name; the job is called "[once] <name>".

prompt.description: What the agent is asked to do or say then, complete on its own.

at.description: The user's local date and time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, no UTC offset.

tools.description: Tool ids the job may use, e.g. ["@@run-code", "web-browsing"]; [] for none.

apply.description: true to make the job, once the user agrees to the preview.
